name: amfx-yield-curve-recession-research
description: amFX reproduction (23NOV22 p3): 3M-10Y yield curve inversion vs recession timing. Every time the curve inverted for 10+ consecutive days, a recession followed (8/8 track record, avg 311 days). Uses Treasury10Y and Treasury3M from common_economic_indicators to compute spread.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: YIELD CURVE INVERSION vs RECESSION (23NOV22 p3)
# =============================================================================
# 3M-10Y yield curve spread with recession shading.
# Perfect track record: 8/8 inversions preceded recessions.
# Average lead time: 311 calendar days (range: 140-487).
# Source: Jim Bianco Research, computed from Treasury10Y - Treasury3M.
# =============================================================================

# 10Y Treasury yield
t10y_src = common_economic_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.Treasury10Y, )()
t10y = ffill(t10y_src.result)

# 3M Treasury yield
t3m_src = common_economic_indicators(category=MacroEconomicsIndicator.Treasury3M, )()
t3m = ffill(t3m_src.result)

# Compute spread: 10Y - 3M
spread = t10y - t3m

idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1: Yield Curve Spread
# =============================================================================
xy_lines(
    title='3M-10Y Yield Curve: Every Inversion Preceded a Recession',
    category='Yield Curve',
    y_axis_label='Spread (10Y - 3M, %)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='10Y-3M Spread', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, title='Inversion Threshold', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(idx, spread)
